subject: Initiative rollout: VP/CTO governance & close pact
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Mills <j.mills@arcadiahealth.com>, Priya Rao <prao@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initiative rollout: VP/CTO governance & close pact

Hi Jordan, Priya —

Thank you for taking the first calls last week. I wanted to put a concise kickoff email in writing so we have a single place for roles, near-term commitments, and an initial timeline toward a commercial close. Our aim with this MAP is to make the evaluation predictable and give your execs the visibility they need.

High-level ask: can we confirm a VP-level exec sponsor (for outcome alignment) and a technical owner (CTO/Head of Platform) for the evaluation plan? Below is a suggested RACI and timeline to get to a signed MSA + pilot by the end of Q3.

Suggested roles (please edit):
- Executive sponsor (outcomes & approvals): Priya Rao (CTO) — final approvals on carveouts and SLA targets
- Day-to-day evaluation lead: Alex Chen (Platform PM) — owns test data, evaluation runs, success metrics
- Procurement/commercial: Jordan Mills — handles T&Cs and PO timing

Proposed 8-week MAP (draft):
1) Week 0 (this week): Align exec outcomes, sign off on evaluation scope + stakeholders
2) Weeks 1–3: Evaluation (pilot tests + perf/latency targets) — weekly checkpoints
3) Week 4: Exec checkpoint (red/amber/green on outcomes)
4) Weeks 5–6: Integration + security sign-off (SOC2 evidence, retention policy)
5) Week 7: Contract prep (commercial redlines routed to finance)
6) Week 8: Sign & pilot kickoff (MSA + SOW)

I've attached a draft MAP spreadsheet (MAP-draft-Arcadia-20280514.xlsx) and a short evaluation-plan stub. Rishi will lead the evaluation plan write-up and Vivek will cover the architecture runbook for the pilot. Marissa will be your CS contact for onboarding sequencing.

Can we schedule a 30-min VP sync next Tue 05/21 10:00–10:30 PT to confirm outcomes and escalation path? If that doesn't work, please propose two windows.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
<aisha@redwood.com>

Attachments: MAP-draft-Arcadia-20280514.xlsx (spreadsheet), evaluation-plan-arcadia-v1.docx (doc)
From: Jordan Mills <j.mills@arcadiahealth.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <prao@arcadiahealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initiative rollout: VP/CTO governance & close pact

Aisha —

Thanks for the clear plan and the worksheet. Priya is happy to be the executive sponsor on our side — she’ll be the primary approver for Q3 commitments. I’m looping Alex Chen (Platform PM) in a separate note for the day-to-day evaluation work and added him to the targets list.

Quick priorities from our side:
- We need clear latency and availability SLOs for the pilot (target 95th p95 <= 150ms for inference under our test load).
- Data retention and SOC2 artifacts are required before system integration begins. Priya’s security team will review the SOC2 checklist you mentioned.
- Procurement timing: if we can get a signed MSA by the end of August, we can allocate budget in Q4.

I can do Tue 05/21 10:00 PT — confirms for the VP sync. Looking forward to the MAP doc.

—Jordan
Jordan Mills
VP, Strategic Partnerships | Arcadia Health
j.mills@arcadiahealth.com
From: Priya Rao <prao@arcadiahealth.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>, Jordan Mills <j.mills@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initiative rollout: VP/CTO governance & close pact

Thanks, Aisha and Jordan. I’ll serve as exec sponsor and will be focused on three Q3 outcomes:
- Outcome 1: Validate inference latency and stability for our 3 canonical workloads
- Outcome 2: Confirm encryption-at-rest + retention policies satisfy our compliance checklist
- Outcome 3: Establish a rollback & escalation plan for production pilots

Security lead: I’ve asked my security manager Alex Chen (alex.chen@arcadiahealth.com) to coordinate evidence collection. We need the SOC2 artifacts you referenced and a list of data flows for our infra team.

On escalation: If we hit a blocker during pilot integration, Priya (CTO) -> Jordan (VP Partnerships) -> Redwood exec (Aisha) should be the escalation path for fast decisions. Please put that explicitly into the MAP doc.

I’ll review the attached MAP draft this afternoon and provide comments.

Priya Rao
CTO | Arcadia Health
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <prao@arcadiahealth.com>, Jordan Mills <j.mills@arcadiahealth.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2028 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Initiative rollout: VP/CTO governance & close pact

Priya/Jordan —

Thanks for confirming the sponsors. Per the MAP draft, I attached a short evaluation plan tailored to Arcadia with the success criteria and test harness we’ll run during Weeks 1–3. Highlights:
- Test harness: three canonical workloads (EHR summarization, clinical Q&A, real-time routing) with expected token distributions attached in the sheet.
- Success criteria: p95 latency <= 150ms, mean accuracy > 92% on our prompt set, and <1.5% error rate on structured outputs.
- Security pre-reqs: SOC2 evidence set + retention policy doc (please see Arcadia-SOC2-questions.pdf).

Next practical steps from Redwood: Vivek will send an architecture runbook and temp keys for the sandbox. I’ll consolidate comments and publish a v1 MAP (x-drive link below) by EOD.

HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/arcadia-health
Drive (MAP v1): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A2bMAPDraft

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions | Redwood Inference

Team —

Appreciate the quick alignment. Quick summary of agreed next steps (I’ll own the MAP updates):
1) Rishi to publish MAP v1 with the evaluation plan comments (EOD 5/15) — done, link above
2) Vivek to provide the sandbox runbook and temporary API keys (ETA 5/17)
3) Arcadia security to review SOC2 checklist; Redwood to deliver evidence packet (attachment: Arcadia-SOC2-questions.pdf)
4) VP sync scheduled: Tue 05/21 10:00–10:30 PT — agenda to include outcome sign-off and escalation confirmation
5) Commercial path: Redwood will route MSA to Jordan’s procurement group once outcome sign-off is green; DocuSign link will be shared for the MSA (https://www.docusign.net/initiatives/RDW-3589-MSA).

Escalation path (to be added to the MAP doc):
- Arcadia: Priya Rao (CTO) -> Jordan Mills (VP Partnerships)
- Redwood: Laura Bennett (Director, Enterprise Sales) -> Aisha Rahman (AE) -> Vivek / Rishi for technical escalation

If everyone is good with this, I’ll drop a MAP v1 final by tomorrow morning and include a short tab with the quarter-by-quarter commitments to make approvals visible for your finance team.

Thanks,
Aisha
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
